<thought>Based on the observed molecular ion (m/z ≈ 182 Da) and the 13C NMR showing an aldehyde carbon (~196 ppm) together with multiple aromatic carbons, the compound is most consistent with syringaldehyde, a 3,5‑dimethoxy‑4‑hydroxybenzaldehyde (C₉H₁₀O₄). Its SMILES representation is “COc1cc(C=O)cc(OC)c1O”.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1cc(C=O)cc(OC)c1O</final_answer>
